evidence / mechanism: Rows of one engine are strongly autocorrelated (smoothed lag-1 ≈ 1). Random row splits put neighbouring cycles of the same engine on both sides, which inflates validation scores.
mitigation: Split by engine (GroupKFold on unit_id within subset); never by row.

risk: unit_id used as a feature or as a cross-file key
evidence / mechanism: unit_id restarts at 1 in every train/test file, so train unit 5 and test unit 5 are different engines. As a feature it is meaningless and lets a model memorise engines.
mitigation: Use (subset, split, unit_id) only as a group key; exclude it from features.

evidence / mechanism: Train RUL is built from each unit's final cycle (future information). Features such as 'fraction of life elapsed', 'cycles until max', or per-unit stats over the whole trajectory (e.g. a unit-level mean/std including future cycles) leak the target.
mitigation: Compute every feature causally (only cycles ≤ t), e.g. trailing rolling windows and expanding stats.

risk: Normalisation / scaler / condition stats fitted on test or validation data
evidence / mechanism: Fitting statistics on test or validation rows (or on all data before splitting) leaks their distribution.
mitigation: Fit on training folds only. Condition assignment by rounding is stateless and safe.

evidence / mechanism: Test units end before failure; validation on full trajectories over-weights easy end-of-life rows and over-estimates accuracy.
mitigation: Evaluate validation engines at random truncation points (one prediction per engine at its last observed cycle).

risk: Cycle number / sequence length as a shortcut
evidence / mechanism: Cycle is correlated with RUL (train rows ρ ≈ −0.58 to −0.79; test length vs true RUL r ≈ −0.41 to −0.68). This is a legitimate age signal, not leakage, but a model can lean on it instead of health signals and fail for unusually long- or short-lived engines.
mitigation: Treat 'cycle' as an explicit, ablatable feature; compare models with and without it.

risk: Tuning on the official test set / RUL files
evidence / mechanism: Using RUL_FD00x for model or hyper-parameter selection turns the test set into a validation set.
mitigation: Touch the test RUL only for the final evaluation.

evidence / mechanism: If subsets are pooled, engines are still distinct, but the subset mix differs between folds and evaluation.
mitigation: Keep the subset as a stratum; report metrics per subset.
